summary: A suite of regression and stability tests was added and tuned: MP4 edit-list preroll behavior is validated around playback start, blob-based playback paths (Blob rebuilt from ArrayBuffer and Blobs read from CacheStorage) have regression tests, MediaFormatReader FPS reporting is checked, and VideoFrame copy logic was hardened to avoid nested Promise/pinning issues. Test infrastructure was also stabilized by enabling a muted-state pref for relevant tests and disabling a flaky Windows ASAN case.
